section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the self-report measures used in the present study, including Body Mass Index (BMI), Compassionate Engagement and Action Scales (CEAS), Acceptance and Action Questionnaire – II (AAQ-II), and Body Appreciation Scale – 2 (BAS-2). section_summary.evidence_source: 2.3. Measures The following self-report measures were administered to participants in its Portuguese-language versions: Body Mass Index (BMI)... Acceptance and Action Questionnaire – II (AAQ-II; Bond et al., 201; Portuguese version by Pinto-Gouveia, Gregório, Dinis, & Xavier, 2012)... Body Appreciation Scale – 2 (BAS-2; Tylka & Wood-Barcalow, 2015b; Portuguese version by Marta-Simões et al., 2016)... The Cronbach's alphas for each study variables for two groups are presented in Table 1.
